headline: 4K 29.97fps video at 208 kbps (0.000279 bits/pixel/frame) with a working, fuzz-hardened, bit-exact decoder; native v6 fused colour kernel, fuzz-hardened

quality.note: ultra-aggressive preset; femto/nano/lean trade bitrate for quality (see rd_table)

decode.note: native colour kernel integrated; interleaved A/B shows >= python, 2-core VM noise floor +/-35%

proof: exhaustive 0/16,777,216 cv2 YCrCb->RGB input grid mismatches
md5 0/150 decoded 4K frames vs python path end-to-end
native_kernel_v4.op_level: colour conversion 54 ms -> 53 ms serial / 24 ms 2-thread (4K plane)
native_kernel_v4.why_not_50x: NumPy plane ops were already vectorized C; honest measurement, see README

guards: level geometry cross-checked vs trusted size chain (kills 2TB numpy bomb)
n_coded <= blocks cap (kills 4-billion-iteration decoder loop DoS)
rANS table entries bounded, zero-frequency tables rejected
all decode failures surface as StreamError; CLI reports and exits rc!=0
security_hardening.remaining_known_gap: no bitstream integrity tag (CRC/MAC): corrupt payload can decode to wrong pixels without error -- roadmap item

native_kernel_v6_fused.what: chroma 2x upsample fused INTO the colour kernel (separable dyadic taps), replacing cv2.resize(x2) + convert at 4K
proof: C vs numpy fallback bit-exact 24/24 random planes + 4K plane
md5 0/1500 mismatches vs pre-change encoder hashes on the real 4K atto stream (stored hashes, full decode)
ASan clean, full regression + 831-case fuzz re-run green
native_kernel_v6_fused.op_level: colour+chroma slice 121-144 ms -> 67-69 ms per 4K frame (~1.8x)
native_kernel_v6_fused.memory: eliminates 132 MB/frame of upsampled f64 chroma intermediates
native_kernel_v6_fused.end_to_end_decode_4k: ~160-170 ms/f (5.9-6.3 f/s); 2-core VM noise floor dominates
native_kernel_v6_fused.bug_found_and_fixed: odd-pixel RGB write offset 3*(j+1) vs 3*j+6 -> heap overflow caught by ASan, fixed

phase_02b_speed_upgrade.step1_tiling_verdict: already parallel: cv2 threads=2 measured 39.1->23.6 ms on the Lanczos resize; fused kernel now OMP-splits rows with threshold 1<<21 (4K fell just under the old 1<<23 cutoff).  No extra python ThreadPool gain available on a 2-core box.
phase_02b_speed_upgrade.step2_float32_verdict: PHOTON_F32=1 env flag; RDT dtype in codec.py (DC chain stays f64).  Enc+dec run the same code path so roundtrip stays locked: 0/20 dec(enc) pixel mismatches, 0.00 dB drift, f64-encoded stream md5s unchanged 0/30.
phase_02b_speed_upgrade.step3_fused_kernel_verdict: chroma up-conversion fused into C colour kernel; a Lanczos L4+add macro kernel is the remaining fuse target.
phase_02b_speed_upgrade.regression: rans none, ASan clean, fuzz 831 clean, decoder_safety PASS, two-pass RC fine

photon-good-4k.measured_4k: 5.5 Mbit/s natural-ish content 38.2 dB; 19.6 Mbit/s noisy content 26.7 dB

photon-good-sd.measured_360p: 1085 kbit/s 31.7 dB, enc 14.6 f/s dec 51.6 f/s

good_internet_tier.design: same PHOTON architecture (base+2 bands at tx_depth=2, all transmitted, short GOP 16, qp 88 -- knee of the quality curve), NOT synthesized like the atto family; ceiling control = --kbps via two-pass RC (rc_family now walks up to good-* rungs, ceiling semantics: settle at first rung <= target)
good_internet_tier.rate_ceiling_demo: target 500 kbit/s -> 356 kbit/s (err 0.71), ladder walked good-sd -> hd-femto automatically
good_internet_tier.bug_fixed: chroma_min_side header slot is u8 (max 255): good-4k chroma base was 400 -> ValueError raised cleanly + preset reduced to 250
good_internet_tier.regression: rans none, decoder_safety PASS, fuzz 831 clean after changes
